title: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:35947:20251230:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 국가관광전략회의의 구성 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Finance and Economy) <No. 35947, December 30, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 2, 2026: Provided, That where a Presidential Decree amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda has been promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but has not yet entered into force, the relevant amendment shall enter into force on the effective date of that Presidential Decree.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (146) Omitted.

(147) Part of the Decree on the Composition and Operation of the National Tourism Strategy Meeting shall be amended as follows:

In Article 4 (1), "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced with "Minister of Finance and Economy", and "Minister of SMEs and Startups" shall be replaced with "Minister of SMEs and Startups and Minister of Planning and Budget".

(148) through (313) Omitted.
